author_may_read_only: the single assignment JSON named in the author's mandate
author_must_not_read: any other language assignment or output
old query panels, oracle, expected, reviews or reports

native_first_rules: Conceive every scenario directly in the assigned language and regional variety; never draft it in another language first.
Do not use a repeated sentence template across cells. Each query must have its own situation, entities, syntax and tone.
Do not mechanically walk the capability list in its listed order.
Use natural regional wording. Avoid caricatures, stereotypes and forced local colour.
Vary imperative, polite, elliptical, colloquial and multi-clause forms where the cell permits it.
Do not include labels, explanations, expected actions or technical registry vocabulary in query text.
Keep requests harmless and free of real secrets or identifying personal data.
If the assigned language cannot express a required distinction naturally, report the problem instead of translating a stock sentence.
known_capability_families_for_scope_only: locate, list, read, create, update, move, share, compress or delete digital files, directories and images
find, read, send, reply to, move or delete messages
find, read, update or delete contacts and persons
find, read, create, update or delete events, calendars and tasks
find, read, create, update or delete issues and pull requests
find or get URLs, places, location, current time, packages, processes, credentials and signatures
filter, sort, group, describe or compute over supplied entries, text, numbers and files
manage a login session, skills and credentials
request approval and undo the immediately preceding assistant turn
outside_scope_families_for_boundary_only: physical-world actions without a registered digital capability
control of an unregistered appliance or vehicle
booking or ordering through an unregistered service

cells_in_exact_order.instruction: Six unrelated ordinary single-intent digital requests from varied capability families.
Three requests containing two or more indispensable known actions that neither consume one another nor require an order.
Three requests with a clear natural producer-to-consumer dependency between known digital actions.
Four complete requests mixing a known digital action with one indispensable understandable outside capability, followed by two understandable outside-only requests. Avoid absurdity.
Six unrelated requests using natural indirectness, ellipsis, politeness, colloquial language, long-distance dependencies or multiple clauses. Most must remain unambiguous.
Two unrelated consequential digital requests with explicit approval or confirmation scope. Make ownership differ between the two.
Two unrelated requests where an otherwise plausible digital action is explicitly negated while another positive action remains.
One clear conditional request whose two branches own different actions and whose order or scope matters.
One natural request only to undo the immediately preceding assistant turn.
One request indispensably combining undo of the immediately preceding turn with a separate digital operation.
One understandable request whose indispensable capability is outside scope and must not be approximated by a known digital action.
